name: gearbox-studio-root
//engines: Theia 1.75 asks for Node >= 24 in its own doc/Developing.md, and its ci-cd.yml build matrix tests exactly [24.x, 26.x] -- so this repeats upstream's tested set instead of inventing one. Node 25 is excluded because it is an odd, non-LTS line nobody upstream builds on. The @theia/* packages declare no engines at all, which is how the previous value -- >=20 <21, our own invention, committed in 8c79cef with no reason given -- went unchallenged until a tool refused to install on it. Recorded in .nvmrc too, so the version lives in the tree rather than in a shell.
//: Every @theia/* pinned to the one version in theia-version.txt, and repeated here as overrides. A transitive ^ pulls a second @theia/core copy, which breaks inversify identity -- the most common Theia build failure.
//monaco-editor-core: Not on theia-version.txt's schedule -- it tracks Monaco, and 1.108.201 is what @theia/monaco 1.75.0 asks for. Pinned for the same reason as the rest and then some: StandaloneServices is a module-level singleton, so a second copy would hand gearbox-studio's monaco.languages.register a different ILanguageService than the one MonacoTextmateService waits on, and .gdl would render as plaintext with no error anywhere.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace gearbox-studio && npm run build --workspace browser-app
scripts.build:release: npm run build --workspace gearbox-studio && npm run build:release --workspace browser-app
scripts.verify: npm run engine && npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run error-smoke && npm run supervision-smoke && npm run store-smoke && npm run conformance && npm run wedge
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace gearbox-studio && npm run build --workspace gearbox-studio-desktop
scripts.package:mac: npm run engine:release && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && npm run build:desktop && npm run package:mac --workspace gearbox-studio-desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run engine:release && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && npm run build:desktop && npm run package:win --workspace gearbox-studio-desktop

//conformance: Playwright, and the browser is a separate explicit step: `npx playwright install chromium`. Playwright has no postinstall of its own -- not in @playwright/test, playwright or playwright-core -- so npm's install-script gate does not apply to it, and nothing downloads 100MB behind your back either.
//engine: The backend spawns ../target/debug/gearbox, so a change to the Rust side is invisible to `npm run build`. Leaving the two out of step cost a debugging session: the client reported a missing source root that the engine had already been taught to send.
